title: LLM GerryMandering: Separating Interactions from Additive Effects in LLM Audits
abstract: arXiv:2611.26538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intersectional bias arises when a model treats people who hold several marginalised identities at once differently from what their separate identities would predict. Auditing such intersectional subgroups remains a challenge: their number grows quadratically, and there is no agreed baseline for what independent attributes would predict. Without such a baseline, many existing audits flag a subgroup when it exceeds each attribute alone, a condition that attributes acting independently already satisfy. We test this standard criterion on 150 synthetic datasets built with no interaction. With the shuffle null, it flags 66.1 false subgroups per dataset on average, and at least one in every dataset. When we plant interactions of known size into these datasets, a repaired null lets the criterion recover only 32% of them. translated_title: LLM“杰利蝾螈”式操纵：在大语言模型审计中分离交互效应与加性效应
translated_abstract: 交叉性偏差是指模型对同时拥有多个边缘化身份的人的对待方式，不同于其各个单独身份所能预测的水平。对这类交叉性子群体的审计依然充满挑战：子群体的数量呈平方级增长，且对于“独立属性本应预测出什么”缺乏公认的基线。在没有这一基线的情况下，许多现有审计只要发现子群体的表现超过任一单独属性就将其标记出来，而属性独立作用时本就满足这一条件。我们在150个不含任何交互作用的合成数据集上检验了这一标准判据：在使用洗牌零假设时，该判据平均每个数据集误报66.1个虚假子群体，且在每个数据集中至少误报一个。当我们在这些数据集中植入已知大小的交互作用后，即便使用修复后的零假设，该判据也只能恢复其中的32%。我们提出了ADDIS（Additive Intersectional Screen，加性交叉性筛选），它在所有属性上拟合一个加性模型，并据此对每个子群体进行评分……
tldr: 该论文揭示了现有交叉性偏差审计判据会把独立属性的加性效应误报为交互偏差（平均每个数据集误报66.1个子群体、真实交互检出率仅32%），并提出ADDIS方法，通过在所有属性上拟合加性模型建立基线，从而真正将交互效应与加性效应分离，准确审计交叉性子群体偏差。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that standard LLM audit criteria falsely flag additive effects of independent attributes as intersectional bias, and introduces ADDIS, which fits an additive model across all attributes to establish a baseline that separates genuine interactional effects from additive ones in subgroup audits.
